action_zones.rationale: Fair value center ~$100, blended: (1) Fwd P/E 40x × $2.57 implied EPS = $102.80; (2) analyst consensus $102.47; (3) EV/EBITDA 30x sector-growth rate applied ~$78. Average of three methods: ~$94. Hold range ±15% centered on $100 = $85-$115, widened to $90-$115 for high-beta (2.31). Buy Below $72 = 28x Fwd EPS, near April trough support. Trim $115 = 45x Fwd EPS, above all analyst targets except bull case. Avoid $130 = ~51x Fwd EPS, requires flawless execution. First-run zones; PDT rule elimination (June 4) strengthens structural floor.
